# Dr. Pavlo Bazilinskyy

> Assistant professor in the Computational Design Systems cluster, Department of Industrial Design, Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e), the Netherlands. Works on AI-driven interaction between automated vehicles, their occupants and other road users (pedestrians, cyclists): external human-machine interfaces (eHMI), crowdsourced and YouTube-based studies of traffic behaviour, driving simulators, virtual reality and auditory interfaces for automated driving. PhD in human factors of automated driving (TU Delft, 2018).

Contact: {{ site.author.email }}. ORCID: 0000-0001-9565-8240.
